save_plan.text: Keep a manual save at the very start of Chapter 1 — your safety net for the whole run.
In Chapter 1, after Lucia is home, do her balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth — it is gone once Chapter 1 ends. Keep the Chapter 1 save until Positive Mental Attitude pops.
Keep one manual save at the start of each chapter (Chapter 2, Chapter 3, Chapter 4) — the game has 15 manual slots plus one autosave.
Save before Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 — the race is time-sensitive (hourglass icon) and the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
Keep one untouched save from just before the final mission — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.
Rotate the remaining slots freely, and never use cheats on your trophy save — cheats switch off trophies and saving.
